name: preflight-path-refs-ignore-aware
title: Review preflight path refs are not ignore-aware
description: Found 2026-08-18 while landing 08-18-opencode-parity-ignores-git. templates/scripts/sd-ai-command-pack-review-preflight.mjs:3198 validates documentation path references with (candidate) => exists(candidate), so a path the repository deliberately git-ignores -- .opencode/package.json, its lockfiles, node_modules -- reads as a missing reference and fails the CI scope lane. Same class of defect as the parity-test bug, in shipped payload this time: existence on disk is being used where 'is this a real, intentional path' is meant. The validator already exempts design.md/implement.md as forward-looking; an ignored-but-intentional path is a third legitimate category, resolvable with git check-ignore. Payload change: needs a manifest bump, make sync, make generate, and a candidate-ledger refresh.
creator: sdelmas
